services.name: Cumberland Island Tour
services.desc: Climb aboard one of our most popular tours to get an extensive and rich history of Amelia and Cumberland Island. Duration 2.5 Hours About One of our most popular tours, this excursion offers an extensive and rich history of Amelia and Cumberland Island with views of wildlife along the way. We cruise by Fernandina’s shrimp boats, historic Old Town, Ft. Clinch State Park, and we look for the wild horses of Cumberland Island. We will share the fascinating history about the ruins of the Carnegie family’s Dungeoness Mansion and the all-inclusive Greyfield Inn. services.name: Cumberland Coastal Tour
services.desc: As we navigate through the waterways of Cumberland Island, you’ll be treated to the island’s history and what life was like for the Carnegie and Rockefeller families during the Industrial Revolution. Enjoy the stories of how the Carnegie Mansion, Dungeoness, turned into ruins. Duration 1.5 Hour About This afternoon tour is a nice blend of history and nature, including a beautiful view of the salt marshes and bird life of Cumberland Island. It offers a close up view of the National Seashore’s shoreline and wading birds, and the history surrounding Cumberland Island’s famous wild horses. What to Bring Please bring a light jacket or garment depending on the weather for your own comfort

services.name: Cumberland Sound Sunset
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing cruise with the family watching the sunset on the horizon, while learning tidbits about the area’s history throughout the trip. Duration 1 Hour About This tour offers a relaxing way for the whole family to take in the sunset out on the water and hear an abbreviated history of the area. Reservations are recommended. What to Bring Please bring a light jacket or garment depending on the weather for your own comfort (recommended Fall through early Spring). Don’t forget to bring your camera, binoculars, sunglasses, and sunscreen! We have cold water aboard for a $1 donation. services.desc: With a glass of your favorite BYOB beverage and wind in your hair, you’ll float away into a natural paradise while being serenaded by one of the area’s finest musicians. Duration 2 Hours About This relaxing cruise is exclusively for adults. Bring your favorite BYOB beverages on board and listen to some of the best musicians on the First Coast. Let all of your worries disappear as a calm appreciation of nature takes over you. Advance purchase required.
